source: MODELED, engine access from each tract's Census internal point
model_notes: Car-free reachability: a destination counts if it is within the walk cap on foot (3 mph straight-line with a 1.3x detour factor) OR reachable by Greenlink on the standard model (<=1 transfer, <=30 min wait, median over departures sampled every 10 minutes across the weekday-midday hour, and a trip must exist from most sampled departures). One representative point per tract, so this is a modeled surface and not an observed trip. Grocery counts SNAP supermarket / super store / grocery store only.
